evidence.title: 湛清轩
evidence.locator: v4 p.337, under 澄心堂; source ref 6-143
evidence.excerpt_zh: 挹爽轩庭灏景赊，四围水木湛清华。芰荷香远汀前漾，杨柳阴浓堤畔遮。波静槛边印明镜，山连楼角写余霞。南湖佳境天然具，试放轻舟溯岸涯。
evidence.summary: Poem 湛清轩 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1815, filed by the editors under 澄心堂.

evidence.title: 绮春园 after 1860, yaffin 系列15
evidence.summary: Lead: says the gate district, 庄严法界, 惠济祠, 湛清轩 and 绿满轩 survived in 1860, the garden was renamed 万春园 under Tongzhi, and was destroyed in 1900, with only 正觉寺 standing. The south gate dates from 1809 and 新宫门 is its later name. Unverified compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 绮春园
evidence.summary: Formed from princes' and ministers' gardens, about 54.3 ha. Taken back from Fuheng's heirs and renamed in 1769; gate, tiger-stone wall and 正觉寺 added by 1773, rebuilt in 1795. Jiaqing's growth came in three stages: the western and central groups of the Thirty Scenes first, then the new gate and eastern scenes, finally the south-west (招凉榭, 湛清轩, 畅和堂, 澄心堂, the shrines), gathered as a New Twenty Scenes.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 澄心堂
evidence.summary: On an island in the south lake of the western group, once 竹园, rebuilt 1815: a five-bay hall in two rolls with a hip-gable annex and side wings, plaques 垂虹榭 and 绮旭轩 on them. 湛清轩 stands on an islet north-east; a three-bay open hall 凌虚亭 stands on the hill across the lake.

evidence.title: 圆明园正觉寺北湖遗址考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey May 2009: the old lake north of the temple wall, east to the west shore of the 鉴碧亭 lake, west to the east shore of 湛清轩. Its tags name an old bridge and a channel. It places QC11, QC08 and QC16 around one water.

evidence.title: 圆明园正觉寺北湖遗址考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey of a lake north of 正觉寺 Zhengjue Si, bounded by the temple's north wall, the west shore of 鉴碧亭's lake and the east shore of 湛清轩. Results paywalled.

evidence.title: 圆明园四宜书屋遗址考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey May 2009: south of the garden, on the north bank of 湛清轩. Three layers down to 1.6 m: rubble, brown soil, yellow-brown soil with sand.

evidence.title: 圆明园四宜书屋遗址考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey around 正觉寺 finds, at the 绮春园 四宜书屋 site, on the north shore of 湛清轩 area: rubble fill to 0.6 m, brown soil with brick scraps to 1.1 m, a harder yellow-brown layer to 1.6 m, then natural ground. Rest paywalled.
